result.summary: The layout is largely coherent, but the horizontal carousels and card styling show several visual defects: clipped text without ellipsis, inconsistent card image treatment, and inconsistent favorite-button styling.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third card is hard-clipped by the viewport edge and its title 'Trattoria Piccol...' and delivery price are cut mid-character with no ellipsis or fade, making it look broken rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a horizontal padding/peek offset so the next card is partially visible by design, truncate labels with text-overflow: ellipsis, and add a gradient fade or snap-scroll indicator.

issues.description: The category chip row ('All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy') is also clipped at the right edge with a sliver of the next chip visible, giving the impression of overflowing content.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent carousel peek spacing and ensure the chip row scroll container has trailing padding so the next chip is clearly a partial preview.

issues.description: Favorite (heart) buttons are inconsistent: the ramen card uses a white circular background with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card uses a dark/transparent circle with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button to a single background and icon treatment across all cards, with a defined active/inactive state.

issues.description: Restaurant thumbnails are visually inconsistent — the 'Green Bowl Poké' image sits on a light gray background while the burger and pasta cards use dark backgrounds, making the row look unbalanced.
issues.suggestion: Apply a uniform image treatment (same background/overlay and aspect ratio) so time badges and cards read consistently.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card is cut off by the bottom navigation bar with no visible scroll affordance, so its name, rating and delivery info are hidden.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset equal to the nav bar height and ensure the last card is either fully visible or clearly partially scrolled.

issues.description: Icon-only controls (notification bell, favorite hearts, search icon) have no visible text labels; if accessible names are missing they will be unusable with screen readers.
issues.suggestion: Provide aria-labels/content descriptions such as 'Notifications', 'Add to favorites', and ensure touch targets are at least 44x44.
